In this video, we dive deep into reading and handling different types of CSV files in Apache Spark using PySpark on Databricks.
You’ll learn how to deal with real-world CSV file challenges like missing headers, special characters, escape sequences, and multi-line records.
All code and data files are available on the below path:
What you’ll learn:
How to create catalogs, schemas, and volumes in Databricks
Uploading and accessing files from volumes
Reading simple CSV files using spark.read.csv() and spark.read.format("csv").load()
Handling headers with .option("header", "true")
